problem: The three MKB Probleemradar blogs were merged to protected main but Netlify production still exposed an older commit, so a canonical Production Source Snapshot refresh is required.
root_cause: The production-source workflow only auto-runs on main when its own workflow file changes, while the Git-linked production deployment had not advanced to the current main lineage. An operational refresh must therefore trigger the canonical exact-source deployment path rather than claiming the merged blogs live.
prevention: After merging website content, compare current protected main with Netlify production commit_ref before claiming LIVE_BEWEZEN.
If Netlify production lags, trigger the canonical Production Source Snapshot through a protected operational refresh rather than bypassing delivery governance.
Never expose or persist transient Netlify proxy credentials in repository content, PR text, workflow inputs, logs, documentation or user-visible output.
Require exact production release identity plus public route readback before marking new articles published.
